ts
import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from '../templates/results/examples/App.vue';
import { navigation, router } from '../templates/results/examples/Runtime.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const apps: ReturnType<typeof createOwnerApp>[] = [];
	const createApp: typeof createOwnerApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};

	const app = createApp(App).use(router);
	await router.isReady();
	if (!(await navigation.reload())) throw new Error('示例导航未能就绪');
	app.mount(element);

	await router.replace('/success');

	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}
ts
import { templateText } from './i18n/index.js';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { TemplateMessageKey } from './i18n/index.js';
import { readonly, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import type { ResultController, ResultFeedback, ResultHost, ResultInput } from './Types.js';

/** 宿主拥有实际业务副作用、router 和 navigation；这里只管理本次展示。 */
export function createResultController<TInput extends ResultInput>(
	initial: TInput,
	initialHost: ResultHost
): ResultController<TInput> {
	const feedback = shallowRef<ResultFeedback>({ phase: 'idle', message: '' });
	const feedbackKey = shallowRef<TemplateMessageKey>();
	function setFeedback(next: { value: ResultFeedback; key?: TemplateMessageKey }) {
		feedbackKey.value = next.key;
		feedback.value = next.value;
	}
	let input = initial;
	let host = initialHost;
	let epoch = 0;
	let disposed = false;
	let abort: AbortController | undefined;
	function invalidate() {
		epoch++;
		abort?.abort();
		abort = undefined;
	}
	function available() {
		return !disposed && !input.disabled && !input.readonly && feedback.value.phase !== 'busy';
	}
	function replace(next: TInput, nextHost = host) {
		if (disposed) return;
		invalidate();
		input = next;
		host = nextHost;
		setFeedback({ value: { phase: 'idle', message: '' } });
	}
	async function recover() {
		if (
			!available() ||
			!host.recovery ||
			!['failure', 'server-error', 'forbidden'].includes(input.kind)
		)
			return;
		const ticket = ++epoch;
		const own = Object.freeze<ResultInput>({ ...input });
		const service = host.recovery;
		abort = new AbortController();
		const signal = abort.signal;
		setFeedback({
			value: { phase: 'busy', message: '正在读取最新结果…' },
			key: 'app.templates.results.readingTheLatestResult'
		});
		try {
			if (service.operation !== 'read' && service.operation !== 'verify')
				throw new Error('非法恢复动作');
			const result = await service.run({ ...own, signal });
			if (disposed || ticket !== epoch) return;
			// 403 的事实由宿主替换页面输入；一次读回不能在本页伪造解锁。
			if (own.kind === 'forbidden' || result.status === 'denied') {
				setFeedback({
					value: {
						phase: 'denied',
						message: '当前仍无访问权限，请联系资源负责人。'
					},
					key: 'app.templates.results.accessIsStillDeniedContactTheResourceOwner'
				});
			} else if (result.status === 'confirmed') {
				setFeedback({
					value: { phase: 'confirmed', message: '已核实结果，可以继续。' },
					key: 'app.templates.results.theResultHasBeenVerifiedYouCanContinue'
				});
			} else {
				setFeedback({
					value: { phase: 'failed', message: '仍未恢复，请稍后重新核实或返回。' },
					key: 'app.templates.results.stillUnavailableVerifyAgainLaterOrReturn'
				});
			}
		} catch (error) {
			if (!disposed && ticket === epoch) {
				setFeedback({
					value: {
						phase: 'failed',
						message: '本次读取失败，原结果未改变。可重新核实或返回。'
					},
					key: 'app.templates.results.thisReadFailedTheOriginalResultIsUnchangedVerify'
				});
				throw error;
			}
		}
	}
	async function go(intent: 'return' | 'next') {
		if (!available()) return;
		if (
			intent === 'next' &&
			!(
				(input.kind === 'success' && input.confirmed === true) ||
				(['failure', 'server-error'].includes(input.kind) &&
					feedback.value.phase === 'confirmed')
			)
		)
			return;
		const requested = intent === 'return' ? input.returnTarget : input.nextTarget;
		const target =
			requested && host.allows(requested)
				? requested
				: intent === 'return'
					? host.fallback
					: undefined;
		if (!target || !host.allows(target)) {
			setFeedback({
				value: { phase: 'failed', message: '没有可用的导航目标，请联系页面负责人。' },
				key: 'app.templates.results.noNavigationTargetIsAvailableContactThePageOwner'
			});
			return;
		}
		const previousPhase = feedback.value.phase;
		const ticket = ++epoch;
		const own = Object.freeze<ResultInput>({ ...input });
		abort = new AbortController();
		const signal = abort.signal;
		setFeedback({
			value: { phase: 'busy', message: '正在打开目标页面…' },
			key: 'app.templates.results.openingTheTargetPage'
		});
		try {
			const accepted = await host.navigate(target, { ...own, signal });
			if (disposed || ticket !== epoch) return;
			setFeedback(
				accepted
					? { value: { phase: 'idle', message: '' } }
					: {
							value: {
								phase: previousPhase === 'confirmed' ? 'confirmed' : 'failed',
								message: '页面未能打开，原业务结果不受影响。请重新导航。'
							},
							key: 'app.templates.results.thePageDidNotOpenTheOriginalBusinessResult'
						}
			);
		} catch (error) {
			if (!disposed && ticket === epoch) {
				setFeedback({
					value: {
						phase: previousPhase === 'confirmed' ? 'confirmed' : 'failed',
						message: '导航失败，原业务结果不受影响。请重新导航。'
					},
					key: 'app.templates.results.navigationFailedTheOriginalBusinessResultIsUnchangedTry'
				});
				throw error;
			}
		}
	}
	return {
		feedback: readonly(feedback),
		formatMessage: (scope: AsamI18n) =>
			scope.enabled.value && feedbackKey.value
				? templateText(scope, feedbackKey.value)
				: feedback.value.message,
		replace,
		recover,
		go,
		dispose() {
			if (!disposed) {
				disposed = true;
				invalidate();
			}
		}
	};
}

.result-page {
	--result-paper: var(--asam-color-surface-page);
	--result-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--result-text: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #252a2c);
	--result-muted: var(--asam-color-text-regular, #434343);
	--result-line: var(--asam-color-border, #d9dedf);
	--result-accent: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	--result-wash: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);
	--result-brand-bg: var(--asam-semantic-primary-soft);
	--result-brand-text: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	--result-tech-canvas: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);
	--result-height: var(--asam-density-default-height, 32px);
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	min-height: calc(100dvh - 64px);
	box-sizing: border-box;
	background: var(--result-paper);
	color: var(--result-text);
	font-family: var(--asam-typography-font-family);
	line-height: 1.6;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.result-page[data-theme='dark'] {
	color-scheme: dark;
}
.result-page[data-size='large'] {
	--result-height: var(--asam-density-large-height, 40px);
}
.result-page[data-size='big'] {
	--result-height: var(--asam-density-big-height, 36px);
}
.result-page[data-size='small'] {
	--result-height: var(--asam-density-small-height, 28px);
}
.result-wordmark {
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 650;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.result-page .el-result {
	padding: 0;
	align-items: stretch;
	text-align: left;
}
.result-page .el-result__title {
	margin: 0;
}
.result-page .el-result__title p {
	font-size: clamp(26px, 3.2vw, 42px);
	font-weight: 600;
	line-height: 1.3;
	letter-spacing: -0.03em;
	color: var(--result-text);
}
.result-page .el-result__subtitle {
	margin-top: 20px;
}
.result-page .el-result__subtitle p {
	color: var(--result-muted);
	line-height: 1.8;
	max-width: 50ch;
}
.result-page .el-result__extra {
	margin-top: 24px;
	text-align: left;
}
.result-page .asam-state-panel-actions {
	justify-content: flex-start;
	gap: 12px;
}
.result-page .asam-state-panel button:not([class*='el-']) {
	min-height: var(--result-height);
	padding: 0 18px;
	border-color: var(--result-line);
	color: var(--result-text);
	background: var(--result-surface);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control, 6px);
}
.result-page .asam-state-panel button:not([class*='el-']):first-child {
	background: var(--asam-semantic-primary-solid);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-on-solid);
	border-color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-solid);
}
.result-page .asam-state-panel button:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 4px;
}
.result-page .asam-state-panel button:not([class*='el-']):active {
	transform: scale(0.98);
}
.result-details {
	color: var(--result-muted);
	font-size: 13px;
	max-width: 65ch;
}
.result-details p {
	margin: 0 0 16px;
}
.result-path bdi {
	display: block;
	font-family: Consolas, monospace;
}
.result-feedback {
	min-height: 24px;
	color: var(--result-text);
}
.result-sr {
	position: absolute;
	width: 1px;
	height: 1px;
	clip-path: inset(50%);
	overflow: hidden;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.result-content {
		animation: result-enter 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
	.result-page button:not([class*='el-']) {
		transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
}
@keyframes result-enter {
	from {
		transform: translateY(6px);
	}
	to {
		transform: translateY(0);
	}
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	.result-page .el-result__title p {
		font-size: 28px;
	}
	.result-page .asam-state-panel-actions {
		gap: 10px;
	}
}

import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { Ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';

export type ResultKind = 'success' | 'failure' | 'forbidden' | 'not-found' | 'server-error';
export type ResultFamily = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech';
export interface ResultIdentity {
	id: string;
	/** 当前宿主路由完整路径。 */
	route: string;
	owner: string;
	scope: string;
	/** 同一结果被替换时递增。 */
	revision: number;
}
export type ResultInput = ResultIdentity & {
	title?: string;
	description?: string;
	/** 只允许公开关联 ID，禁止传入凭据或堆栈。 */
	correlationId?: string;
	returnTarget?: string;
	nextTarget?: string;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
} & (
		| { kind: 'success'; confirmed: true }
		| { kind: 'failure' | 'server-error'; writeState: 'unknown' | 'failed' }
		| { kind: 'forbidden' }
		| { kind: 'not-found'; unknownPath: string }
	);
export type RecoveryOutcome =
	| { status: 'confirmed'; message?: string }
	| { status: 'still-failed'; message?: string }
	| { status: 'denied' };
export interface ReadRecovery {
	/** 此契约只允许读取或核实，不能用来重发业务写入。 */
	operation: 'read' | 'verify';
	run: (
		context: Readonly<ResultInput> & { signal: AbortSignal }
	) => RecoveryOutcome | Promise<RecoveryOutcome>;
}
export interface ResultHost {
	/** key 到目标的映射由宿主显式定义，并由 032 navigation 处理。 */
	allows: (target: string) => boolean;
	/** 延迟实际导航的宿主必须在副作用前核对 signal 与此固定身份。 */
	navigate: (
		target: string,
		context: Readonly<ResultInput> & { signal: AbortSignal }
	) => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
	fallback: string;
	recovery?: ReadRecovery;
}
export interface ResultPageProps {
	/** 仅展示层覆盖，不改变原动作或结果状态。 */
	tone?: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';
	/** 显示公共状态组件原生图标；默认保留旧简约页的代码标记。 */
	nativeIcon?: boolean;
	actionLabels?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
	/** 将已有具名动作按公共按钮主色呈现，不新增或替换动作。 */
	primaryAction?: string;
	/** 简约回执可接入内容区预览；未提供时保持原浏览器打印行为。 */
	printReceipt?: (context: Readonly<ResultInput>) => void | Promise<void>;
	input: ResultInput;
	host: ResultHost;
	size?: AsamControlSize;
	theme?: 'light' | 'dark';
}
/** 原样转发 030 的动作协议；success 表示动作完成，不等同于业务恢复。 */
export interface ResultPageEmits {
	start: [id: string];
	success: [id: string];
	failure: [id: string, error: unknown];
}
export interface ResultPageEmitter {
	(event: 'start', id: string): void;
	(event: 'success', id: string): void;
	(event: 'failure', id: string, error: unknown): void;
}
export interface ResultFeedback {
	phase: 'idle' | 'busy' | 'confirmed' | 'failed' | 'denied';
	message: string;
}
export interface ResultController<TInput extends ResultInput = ResultInput> {
	feedback: Readonly<Ref<ResultFeedback>>;
	formatMessage?: (scope: AsamI18n) => string;
	replace: (input: TInput, host?: ResultHost) => void;
	recover: () => Promise<void>;
	go: (intent: 'return' | 'next') => Promise<void>;
	dispose: () => void;
}

import { useTemplateI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import { defineComponent, h, ref } from 'vue';
import { createNavigation } from '../navigation/Navigation.js';
import ResultRoute from './ResultRoute.vue';
import { createSyntheticService } from './Service.js';
import type { SyntheticMode } from './Service.js';
import type { ResultFamily, ResultHost, ResultInput, ResultKind } from '../Types.js';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const requestedFamily = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('family');
export const family = ref<ResultFamily>(
	requestedFamily === 'brand' || requestedFamily === 'tech' ? requestedFamily : 'minimal'
);
export const theme = ref<'light' | 'dark'>(
	requestedFamily === 'tech' || matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
		? 'dark'
		: 'light'
);
export const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('default');
export const mode = ref<SyntheticMode>('confirm');
export const longText = ref(false);
export const empty = ref(false);
export const disabled = ref(false);
export const readonly = ref(false);
export const owner = ref('demo-reader');
export const mounted = ref(true);
export const double = ref(false);
export const navigationFails = ref(false);
export const synthetic = createSyntheticService();
const Landing = defineComponent(() => {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	return () =>
		h('main', { class: 'demo-landing' }, [
			h('h1', i18n.t('app.templates.results.workspace')),
			h('p', i18n.t('app.templates.results.navigationArrived'))
		]);
});
const Record = defineComponent(() => {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	return () =>
		h('main', { class: 'demo-landing' }, [
			h('h1', i18n.t('app.templates.results.record')),
			h('p', i18n.t('app.templates.results.verifiedDemoRecord'))
		]);
});
export const router = createRouter({
	history: createWebHistory(),
	routes: [
		{ path: '/', redirect: '/home' },
		{ path: '/success', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'success' } },
		{ path: '/failure', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'failure' } },
		{ path: '/403', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'forbidden' } },
		{ path: '/404', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'not-found' } },
		{ path: '/500', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'server-error' } },
		{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'not-found' } }
	]
});
// 032 的固定同版源码快照，只读且原字节；本应用拥有此实例并负责释放。
export const navigation = createNavigation({
	router,
	components: { home: Landing, record: Record },
	fallback: '/home',
	scope: 'synthetic-workspace',
	load: async () => [
		{ id: 'home', path: '/home', title: '工作台', resource: 'home', cache: false },
		{ id: 'record', path: '/record', title: '处理记录', resource: 'record', cache: false }
	]
});
export const targets: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = Object.freeze({
	home: 'home',
	record: 'record'
});
export function createHost(): ResultHost {
	return {
		allows: (target) =>
			Object.hasOwn(targets, target) &&
			navigation.menu.value.some((item) => item.id === targets[target]),
		navigate: (target, context) =>
			context.signal.aborted ||
			context.owner !== owner.value ||
			context.route !== router.currentRoute.value.fullPath ||
			navigationFails.value
				? false
				: navigation.navigate(navigation.location(targets[target]!)),
		fallback: 'home',
		recovery: synthetic.service(mode.value)
	};
}
/** 示例宿主决定结果种类；不根据任意错误数字推断业务成功。 */
export function inputFor(kind: ResultKind, route: string, instance = 'primary'): ResultInput {
	const identity = {
		id: `synthetic-${instance}`,
		route,
		owner: owner.value,
		scope: 'workspace-demo',
		revision: 1
	};
	const common = {
		...identity,
		returnTarget: 'home',
		nextTarget: 'record',
		disabled: disabled.value,
		readonly: readonly.value,
		...(longText.value
			? {
					title: '这是一条需要在较窄屏幕上完整阅读并且允许自然换行的处理结果标题',
					description: '请核对本次处理的状态与相关说明。'.repeat(12)
				}
			: {}),
		...(empty.value
			? { title: '', description: '', correlationId: '' }
			: { correlationId: 'DEMO-READ-824' })
	};
	if (kind === 'success') return { ...common, kind, confirmed: true };
	if (kind === 'failure' || kind === 'server-error')
		return { ...common, kind, writeState: 'unknown' };
	if (kind === 'not-found') return { ...common, kind, unknownPath: route.split('?')[0]! };
	return { ...common, kind };
}
export function disposeOwnedRuntime() {
	navigation.dispose();
	synthetic.dispose();
}
ts
import type { ReadRecovery, RecoveryOutcome } from '../Types.js';

export type SyntheticMode = 'confirm' | 'fail' | 'throw' | 'reject' | 'denied' | 'late';
/** 只在当前浏览器内合成读取，没有 fetch、账户或业务写入。 */
export function createSyntheticService() {
	let calls = 0;
	const outstanding = new Map<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>, () => void>();
	let disposed = false;
	function service(mode: SyntheticMode): ReadRecovery {
		return {
			operation: 'verify',
			run(context) {
				if (disposed) throw new Error('示例服务已关闭');
				calls++;
				if (mode === 'throw') throw new Error('合成同步失败');
				if (mode === 'reject') return Promise.reject(new Error('合成异步失败'));
				return new Promise<RecoveryOutcome>((resolve) => {
					const finish = () => {
						outstanding.delete(timer);
						context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
						resolve(
							mode === 'denied'
								? { status: 'denied' }
								: mode === 'fail'
									? { status: 'still-failed' }
									: { status: 'confirmed' }
						);
					};
					const cancel = () => {
						clearTimeout(timer);
						finish();
					};
					const timer = setTimeout(finish, mode === 'late' ? 900 : 80);
					outstanding.set(timer, cancel);
					context.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
					if (context.signal.aborted) cancel();
				});
			}
		};
	}
	return {
		service,
		get calls() {
			return calls;
		},
		dispose() {
			disposed = true;
			for (const cancel of [...outstanding.values()]) cancel();
		}
	};
}

		class="result-page minimal-page"
		:class="{ 'minimal-receipt': businessResult }"
		:data-theme="theme"
		:data-size="size ?? 'default'"
		data-family="minimal"
	>
		<header class="minimal-mast">
			<span class="result-wordmark">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.asamWorkspace') }}</span
			><span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.operationResult') }}</span>
		</header>
		<component
			:is="businessResult ? AsamCard : 'div'"
			v-bind="
				businessResult
					? {
							shadow: 'never',
							bordered: true,
							bodyStyle: { padding: 'var(--asam-space-xl, 24px)' }
						}
					: {}
			"
			class="minimal-body"
			><div
				v-if="!businessResult"
				class="minimal-index"
				:data-code="content.code"
				:data-kind="input.kind"
				aria-hidden="true"
			>
				{{ content.code }}
			</div>
			<component
				:is="panel"
				:title="title"
				:description="description"
				:tone="tone ?? content.tone"
				:actions="actions"
				:state-key="stateKey"
				:size="size"
				:readonly="input.readonly"
				:disabled="input.disabled"
				@start="start"
				@success="success"
				@failure="failure"
				class="result-content"
				><template v-if="!businessResult && !nativeIcon" #icon
					><span class="result-sr">{{ content.code }}</span></template
				><slot name="receipt" :input="input" />
				<div class="result-details">
					<p v-if="path" class="result-path">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.requestedPath') }} <bdi>{{ path }}</bdi>
					</p>
					<p v-if="correlation">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.correlationId') }}
						<bdi>{{ correlation }}</bdi>
					</p>
					<p v-if="input.kind === 'failure' && input.writeState === 'unknown'">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.theWriteResultIsUnknownVerifyIt') }}
					</p>

			}}<span>ASAM WORKSPACE</span>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
import { AsamCard } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();

import type { ResultPageEmits, ResultPageProps } from '../Types.js';
import type { AsamStateAction } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { useResultPage } from '../useResultPage.js';
import { computed, nextTick, onScopeDispose, useSlots } from 'vue';
const props = defineProps<ResultPageProps & { verifyOnly?: boolean }>();
const businessResult = computed(() => props.input.kind === 'success');
const slots = useSlots();
const emit = defineEmits<ResultPageEmits>();
const {
	content,
	actions: navigationActions,
	panel,
	path,
	correlation,
	stateKey,
	feedback,
	start,
	success,
	failure
} = useResultPage(props, emit);
const title = computed(() =>
	businessResult.value && slots.receipt && props.input.title === undefined
		? i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSuccessTitle')
		: content.value.title
);
const description = computed(() =>
	businessResult.value && slots.receipt && props.input.description === undefined
		? i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSuccessDescription')
		: content.value.description
);
let active = true;
onScopeDispose(() => {
	active = false;
});
const actions = computed<readonly AsamStateAction[]>(() => {
	const ownState = stateKey.value;
	// 展示属性通过getter读取，避免文案/主色变化替换030仍在执行的动作。
	const existing = navigationActions.value.map<AsamStateAction>((action) => ({
		id: action.id,
		run: action.run,
		get disabled() {
			return action.disabled;
		},
		get button(): AsamStateAction['button'] {
			return props.primaryAction === action.id
				? { type: 'primary', plain: false }
				: action.button;
		},
		get label() {
			return props.actionLabels?.[action.id] ?? action.label;
		}
	}));
	if (props.verifyOnly) return existing.filter((action) => action.id === 'recover');
	if (!businessResult.value || !slots.receipt) return existing;
	return [
		...existing
			.filter((action) => action.id === 'next')
			.map<AsamStateAction>((action) => ({
				...action,
				button: { type: 'primary', plain: false },
				get label() {
					return i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptViewRequest');
				}
			})),
		{
			id: 'print-receipt',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptPrint');
			},
			run: async () => {
				await nextTick();
				if (
					active &&
					stateKey.value === ownState &&
					props.input.kind === 'success' &&
					props.input.confirmed &&
					!props.input.disabled &&
					!props.input.readonly
				)
					await (props.printReceipt ?? (() => window.print()))(
						Object.freeze({ ...props.input })
					);
			}
		},
		...existing.filter((action) => action.id !== 'next')
	];
});
</script>

export type { ResultsMessageParameters } from './Parameters.js';
export type TemplateMessageKey = {
	[K in keyof ResultsMessageParameters]: keyof ResultsMessageParameters[K] extends never
		? K
		: never;
}[keyof ResultsMessageParameters];

export function templateText(scope: AsamI18n, key: TemplateMessageKey): string {
	return scope.t(...([key] as TemplateMessageCall));
}

import { computed, markRaw, readonly, ref, shallowRef, shallowReadonly } from 'vue';
import { createRouterMatcher, isNavigationFailure, NavigationFailureType } from 'vue-router';
import type {
	RouteRecordRaw,
	RouteLocationRaw,
	RouteLocationNormalized,
	RouteLocationNormalizedLoaded
} from 'vue-router';
import type {
	NavigationAction,
	NavigationItem,
	NavigationOptions,
	NavigationTab
} from './Types.js';

/** One application module. The host owns the router and all routes outside this module. */
export function createNavigation(options: NavigationOptions) {
	const { router } = options;
	const menu = shallowRef<readonly NavigationItem[]>([]);
	const tabs = ref<NavigationTab[]>([]);
	const error = ref('');
	const loading = ref(false);
	const revision = ref(0);
	const active = ref('');
	const retained = ref<string[]>([]);
	const namespace = `asam-navigation-${++moduleSequence}:`;
	let generation = 0;
	let operation = 0;
	let action = 0;
	let disposed = false;
	let scope = options.scope ?? '';
	let abort: AbortController | undefined;
	let removers: (() => void)[] = [];
	let records: RouteRecordRaw[] = [];
	const max = options.maxCache ?? 10;
	if (!Number.isInteger(max) || max < 1) throw new Error('maxCache 必须为正整数');
	const name = (id: string) => namespace + id;
	const currentItem = (route: RouteLocationNormalized) =>
		menu.value.find((item) => route.name === name(item.id));
	const fail = (message: string) => {
		error.value = message;
		return false;
	};
	async function permitted(action: NavigationAction) {
		try {
			return (await options.confirm?.(action, router.currentRoute.value)) !== false;
		} catch {
			return fail('离开确认失败，请重试');
		}
	}
	function visit(route: RouteLocationNormalizedLoaded) {
		if (disposed) return;
		const item = currentItem(route);
		if (!item) {
			active.value = '';
			return;
		}
		const id = route.fullPath;
		let cacheKey: string;
		try {
			cacheKey = options.cacheKey ? options.cacheKey(route, item) : route.fullPath;
		} catch {
			fail('cacheKey 计算失败，请检查宿主配置');
			return;
		}
		if (typeof cacheKey !== 'string' || !cacheKey) {
			fail('cacheKey 必须为非空字符串');
			return;
		}
		let tab = tabs.value.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
		if (!tab) {
			tab = {
				id,
				routeId: item.id,
				fullPath: route.fullPath,
				title: item.title,
				cacheKey: JSON.stringify([item.id, cacheKey]),
				cache: item.cache !== false,
				pinned: !!item.pinned,
				epoch: 0
			};
			tabs.value.push(tab);
		}
		active.value = id;
		if (tab.cache) {
			retained.value = [
				...retained.value.filter((key) => key !== tab.cacheKey),
				tab.cacheKey
			].slice(-max);
		}
	}
	// The guard also covers host push/replace and browser back/forward.
	const removeGuard = router.beforeEach(async (to, from) => {
		if (disposed || to.fullPath === from.fullPath) return true;
		const item = currentItem(to);
		if (item) {
			try {
				const key = options.cacheKey ? options.cacheKey(to, item) : to.fullPath;
				if (typeof key !== 'string' || !key) return fail('cacheKey 必须为非空字符串');
			} catch {
				return fail('cacheKey 计算失败，请检查宿主配置');
			}
		}
		const token = ++operation;
		const accepted = await permitted('navigate');
		return !disposed && token === operation && accepted;
	});
	const removeAfter = router.afterEach((to, _from, failure) => {
		if (!failure) visit(to);
	});
	async function navigate(target: RouteLocationRaw, replace = false) {
		if (disposed) return false;
		error.value = '';
		try {
			const resolved = router.resolve(target);
			if (!resolved.matched.length) return fail('未匹配的页面');
			const result = await (replace ? router.replace(target) : router.push(target));
			if (isNavigationFailure(result)) {
				// Duplicate navigation is a successful no-op only when already at the target.
				return (
					isNavigationFailure(result, NavigationFailureType.duplicated) &&
					router.currentRoute.value.fullPath === resolved.fullPath
				);
			}
			return !disposed;
		} catch {
			return fail('导航失败，请重试');
		}
	}
	function validate(input: readonly NavigationItem[]) {
		if (!Array.isArray(input)) throw new Error('菜单必须为数组');
		const ids = new Set<string>();
		const paths = new Set<string>();
		const copy = input.map((entry) => {
			if (!entry || typeof entry.id !== 'string' || !entry.id.trim() || ids.has(entry.id))
				throw new Error('非法或重复菜单 id');
			if (
				typeof entry.path !== 'string' ||
				!entry.path.startsWith('/') ||
				paths.has(pathShape(entry.path))
			)
				throw new Error('非法或冲突路径');
			if (typeof entry.title !== 'string' || !entry.title.trim())
				throw new Error('缺少菜单标题');
			if (!Object.hasOwn(options.components, entry.resource)) throw new Error('未知页面资源');
			if (
				router.hasRoute(name(entry.id)) &&
				!records.some((record) => record.name === name(entry.id))
			)
				throw new Error('命名路由与宿主冲突');
			if (
				router
					.getRoutes()
					.some(
						(route) =>
							pathShape(route.path) === pathShape(entry.path) &&
							!records.some((record) => record.name === route.name)
					)
			)
				throw new Error('路径与宿主冲突');
			ids.add(entry.id);
			paths.add(pathShape(entry.path));
			return Object.freeze({ ...entry });
		});
		for (const item of copy) {
			const seen = new Set([item.id]);
			let parent = item.parentId;
			while (parent) {
				if (seen.has(parent)) throw new Error('菜单父子循环');
				seen.add(parent);
				const found = copy.find((entry) => entry.id === parent);
				if (!found) throw new Error('菜单父级不存在');
				parent = found.parentId;
			}
		}
		return copy;
	}
	async function reload(nextScope = scope) {
		if (disposed) return false;
		const token = ++generation;
		abort?.abort();
		abort = new AbortController();
		scope = nextScope;
		loading.value = true;
		error.value = '';
		try {
			const next = validate(await options.load({ signal: abort.signal, scope }));
			if (disposed || token !== generation) return false;
			const nextRecords: RouteRecordRaw[] = next.map((item) => ({
				path: item.path,
				name: name(item.id),
				component: markRaw(options.components[item.resource]!),
				props: true,
				meta: { navigationId: item.id, iframe: item.iframe }
			}));
			// Use Vue Router's own registration parser before confirmation/navigation.
			// This disposable matcher owns no history, guards or application routes.
			createRouterMatcher(nextRecords, router.options);
			const current = currentItem(router.currentRoute.value);
			const changedCurrent =
				current &&
				!next.some(
					(item) =>
						item.id === current.id &&
						item.path === current.path &&
						item.resource === current.resource
				);
			if (changedCurrent && !(await permitted('update'))) return false;
			if (disposed || token !== generation) return false;
			// Navigate before removal. Cancellation preserves both the installed version and tabs.
			if (changedCurrent && !(await navigate(options.fallback, true))) return false;
			if (disposed || token !== generation) return false;
			removers.forEach((remove) => remove());
			const installed: (() => void)[] = [];
			try {
				for (const record of nextRecords) installed.push(router.addRoute(record));
			} catch (cause) {
				installed.forEach((remove) => remove());
				removers = records.map((record) => router.addRoute(record));
				throw cause;
			}
			removers = installed;
			records = nextRecords;
			action++;
			const stale = new Set(
				menu.value
					.filter(
						(old) =>
							!next.some(
								(item) =>
									item.id === old.id &&
									item.path === old.path &&
									item.resource === old.resource
							)
					)
					.map((item) => item.id)
			);
			tabs.value = tabs.value.filter((tab) => !stale.has(tab.routeId));
			menu.value = next;
			for (const tab of tabs.value) {
				const item = next.find((entry) => entry.id === tab.routeId)!;
				tab.title = item.title;
				tab.pinned = !!item.pinned;
				tab.cache = item.cache !== false;
			}
			prune();
			revision.value++;
			// Re-resolve initial deep links after dynamic registration.
			await navigate(router.currentRoute.value.fullPath, true);
			visit(router.currentRoute.value);
			return true;
		} catch {
			if (!disposed && token === generation) fail('菜单加载或校验失败，保留上一版本，可重试');
			return false;
		} finally {
			if (!disposed && token === generation) loading.value = false;
		}
	}
	function prune() {
		retained.value = retained.value.filter((key) =>
			tabs.value.some((tab) => tab.cache && tab.cacheKey === key)
		);
	}
	async function close(ids: readonly string[]) {
		if (disposed) return false;
		const closing = tabs.value.filter((tab) => ids.includes(tab.id) && !tab.pinned);
		if (!closing.length) return true;
		const token = ++action;
		if (!(await permitted('close')) || disposed || token !== action) return false;
		if (closing.some((tab) => tab.id === active.value)) {
			const survivor = tabs.value.find(
				(tab) => !closing.some((entry) => entry.id === tab.id)
			);
			if (!(await navigate(survivor?.fullPath ?? options.fallback))) return false;
		}
		if (disposed || token !== action) return false;
		tabs.value = tabs.value.filter((tab) => !closing.some((entry) => entry.id === tab.id));
		prune();
		return true;
	}
	async function refresh(id = active.value) {
		const token = ++action;
		if (!(await permitted('refresh')) || disposed || token !== action) return false;
		const tab = tabs.value.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
		if (!tab) return false;
		// All tabs sharing an explicit cache identity refer to the same refreshed instance.
		for (const entry of tabs.value) if (entry.cacheKey === tab.cacheKey) entry.epoch++;
		return true;
	}
	function move(id: string, targetId: string) {
		if (disposed) return;
		const from = tabs.value.findIndex((tab) => tab.id === id && !tab.pinned);
		const to = tabs.value.findIndex((tab) => tab.id === targetId && !tab.pinned);
		if (from < 0 || to < 0 || from === to) return;
		const [tab] = tabs.value.splice(from, 1);
		tabs.value.splice(to, 0, tab!);
	}
	const pages = computed(() => {
		const unique = new Map<string, NavigationTab>();
		for (const tab of tabs.value)
			if ((tab.cache && retained.value.includes(tab.cacheKey)) || tab.id === active.value)
				unique.set(tab.cacheKey, tab);
		const current = tabs.value.find((tab) => tab.id === active.value);
		if (current) unique.set(current.cacheKey, current);
		return [...unique.values()];
	});
	function dispose() {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		generation++;
		operation++;
		action++;
		abort?.abort();
		removeGuard();
		removeAfter();
		removers.forEach((remove) => remove());
		tabs.value = [];
		menu.value = [];
		retained.value = [];
		loading.value = false;
	}
	return {
		menu: shallowReadonly(menu),
		tabs: readonly(tabs),
		pages,
		active: readonly(active),
		error: readonly(error),
		loading: readonly(loading),
		revision: readonly(revision),
		router,
		visibleMenu: computed(() =>
			menu.value.filter((item) => !item.hidden && (options.visible?.(item) ?? true))
		),
		navigate,
		reload,
		close,
		refresh,
		move,

import type { Component } from 'vue';
import type {
	Router,
	RouteLocationNormalizedLoaded,
	RouteLocationNormalized,
	RouteLocationRaw
} from 'vue-router';

export interface NavigationItem {
	id: string;
	parentId?: string;
	path: string;
	/** Optional menu landing location for a parameterized route. */
	location?: RouteLocationRaw;
	title: string;
	icon?: string;
	resource: string;
	cache?: boolean;
	pinned?: boolean;
	hidden?: boolean;
	iframe?: string;
}
export interface NavigationTab {
	id: string;
	routeId: string;
	fullPath: string;
	title: string;
	cacheKey: string;
	cache: boolean;
	pinned: boolean;
	epoch: number;
}
export type NavigationAction = 'navigate' | 'close' | 'refresh' | 'update';
export interface NavigationOptions {
	router: Router;
	/** Explicit allowlist. Remote strings never become import paths. */
	components: Readonly<Record<string, Component>>;
	load: (context: { signal: AbortSignal; scope: string }) => Promise<readonly NavigationItem[]>;
	fallback: RouteLocationRaw;
	scope?: string;
	confirm?: (
		action: NavigationAction,
		from: RouteLocationNormalizedLoaded
	) => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
	visible?: (item: Readonly<NavigationItem>) => boolean;
	cacheKey?: (route: RouteLocationNormalized, item: Readonly<NavigationItem>) => string;
	/** Number of retained page instances; default 10. */
	maxCache?: number;
}
export interface EmbedPolicy {
	resolve: (input: string) => string;
	allow: (url: URL) => boolean;
	sandbox?: string;
	permissions?: string;
	referrerPolicy?: ReferrerPolicy;
}

import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { computed, nextTick, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamException, AsamStatePanel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import type { AsamStateAction } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createResultController } from './Controller.js';
import type { ResultKind, ResultPageEmitter, ResultPageProps } from './Types.js';

export function useResultPage(props: ResultPageProps, emit: ResultPageEmitter = () => {}) {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	const copy = computed<
		Record<
			ResultKind,
			{
				title: string;
				description: string;
				code: string;
				tone: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';
			}
		>
	>(() => ({
		success: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.submissionComplete'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theHostConfirmedTheResultViewTheRecordOr'),
			code: i18n.t('app.templates.results.complete'),
			tone: 'success'
		},
		failure: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theOperationDidNotComplete'),
			description: i18n.t(
				'app.templates.results.verifyTheLatestResultBeforeDecidingWhatToDo'
			),
			code: i18n.t('app.templates.results.needsAttention'),
			tone: 'warning'
		},
		forbidden: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.thisPageIsCurrentlyUnavailableToYou'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.youDoNotHaveAccessToThisResourceRead'),
			code: '403',
			tone: 'warning'
		},
		'not-found': {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.pageNotFound'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theAddressMayHaveChangedCheckThePathOr'),
			code: '404',
			tone: 'info'
		},
		'server-error': {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theServiceIsTemporarilyUnavailable'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.noResultWasReceivedReadTheStatusAgainOr'),
			code: '500',
			tone: 'error'
		}
	}));
	const controller = createResultController(props.input, props.host);
	// 只跟随 030 公开事件固定 actions 身份，按钮 pending/disabled/aria-busy 仍全部由 030 管理。
	const executing = shallowRef(false);
	const generation = shallowRef(0);
	let disposed = false;
	const stateKey = computed(() =>
		JSON.stringify([
			props.input.id,
			props.input.kind,
			props.input.route,
			props.input.owner,
			props.input.scope,
			props.input.revision,
			props.input.disabled,
			props.input.readonly
		])
	);
	watch(
		() => [stateKey.value, props.input, props.host],
		() => {
			generation.value++;
			executing.value = false;
			controller.replace(props.input, props.host);
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	onScopeDispose(() => {
		disposed = true;
		generation.value++;
		controller.dispose();
	});
	function start(id: string) {
		executing.value = true;
		emit('start', id);
	}
	function success(id: string) {
		// 此时 030 已完成本次执行。先释放，再通知宿主，允许回调同步启动下一次动作。
		executing.value = false;
		emit('success', id);
	}
	function failure(id: string, error: unknown) {
		executing.value = false;
		emit('failure', id, error);
	}
	const verified = computed(
		() => props.input.kind !== 'success' || props.input.confirmed === true
	);
	const content = computed(() => ({
		...copy.value[props.input.kind],
		title: verified.value
			? props.input.title || copy.value[props.input.kind].title
			: i18n.t('app.templates.results.resultNotYetConfirmed'),
		description: verified.value
			? props.input.description || copy.value[props.input.kind].description
			: i18n.t('app.templates.results.waitForTheHostToConfirmTheBusinessResult'),
		tone: verified.value ? copy.value[props.input.kind].tone : ('info' as const)
	}));
	const actions = computed<readonly AsamStateAction[]>((previous) => {
		const own = generation.value;
		// feedback 已结算不代表 030 的 await 已结算；直到其真实终结事件才更新动作列表。
		if (executing.value && previous) return previous;
		const run = (action: () => Promise<void>) => async () => {
			// start 回调可以同步替换输入/卸载；先让 Vue 提交这些变更，再核本动作身份。
			await nextTick();
			if (!disposed && own === generation.value) await action();
		};
		const list: AsamStateAction[] = [];
		if (
			props.host.recovery &&
			['failure', 'server-error', 'forbidden'].includes(props.input.kind)
		)
			list.push({
				id: 'recover',
				get label() {
					return props.input.kind === 'forbidden'
						? i18n.t('app.templates.results.readPermissionsAgain')
						: i18n.t('app.templates.results.verifyAgain');
				},
				run: run(controller.recover)
			});
		if (
			props.input.nextTarget &&
			props.host.allows(props.input.nextTarget) &&
			((props.input.kind === 'success' && verified.value) ||
				(['failure', 'server-error'].includes(props.input.kind) &&
					controller.feedback.value.phase === 'confirmed'))
		)
			list.push({
				id: 'next',
				get label() {
					return i18n.t('app.templates.results.viewRecord');
				},
				run: run(() => controller.go('next'))
			});
		list.push({
			id: 'return',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.results.returnToWorkspace');
			},
			run: run(() => controller.go('return'))
		});
		return list;
	});
	const panel = computed(() => (props.input.kind === 'success' ? AsamStatePanel : AsamException));
	const path = computed(() =>
		props.input.kind === 'not-found' ? props.input.unknownPath.slice(0, 160) : ''
	);
	const correlation = computed(() => props.input.correlationId?.slice(0, 80) || '');
	return {
		content,
		actions,
		panel,
		path,
		correlation,
		stateKey,
		feedback: computed(() => ({
			...controller.feedback.value,
			message: controller.formatMessage?.(i18n) ?? controller.feedback.value.message
		})),
		start,
		success,
		failure
	};
}

import { createApp as createOwnerApp } from 'vue';
import { AsamI18nKey } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import App from '../templates/results/examples/App.vue';
import { navigation, router } from '../templates/results/examples/Runtime.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(element, onError, i18n) {
	const apps = [];
	const createApp = (...args) => {
		const app = createOwnerApp(...args);
		if (i18n) app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
		app.config.errorHandler = onError;
		apps.push(app);
		return app;
	};
	const app = createApp(App).use(router);
	await router.isReady();
	if (!(await navigation.reload())) throw new Error('示例导航未能就绪');
	app.mount(element);
	await router.replace('/success');
	return () => {
		for (const app of apps.reverse()) app.unmount();
	};
}

import { templateText } from './i18n/index.js';
import { readonly, shallowRef } from 'vue';
/** 宿主拥有实际业务副作用、router 和 navigation；这里只管理本次展示。 */
export function createResultController(initial, initialHost) {
	const feedback = shallowRef({ phase: 'idle', message: '' });
	const feedbackKey = shallowRef();
	function setFeedback(next) {
		feedbackKey.value = next.key;
		feedback.value = next.value;
	}
	let input = initial;
	let host = initialHost;
	let epoch = 0;
	let disposed = false;
	let abort;
	function invalidate() {
		epoch++;
		abort?.abort();
		abort = undefined;
	}
	function available() {
		return !disposed && !input.disabled && !input.readonly && feedback.value.phase !== 'busy';
	}
	function replace(next, nextHost = host) {
		if (disposed) return;
		invalidate();
		input = next;
		host = nextHost;
		setFeedback({ value: { phase: 'idle', message: '' } });
	}
	async function recover() {
		if (
			!available() ||
			!host.recovery ||
			!['failure', 'server-error', 'forbidden'].includes(input.kind)
		)
			return;
		const ticket = ++epoch;
		const own = Object.freeze({ ...input });
		const service = host.recovery;
		abort = new AbortController();
		const signal = abort.signal;
		setFeedback({
			value: { phase: 'busy', message: '正在读取最新结果…' },
			key: 'app.templates.results.readingTheLatestResult'
		});
		try {
			if (service.operation !== 'read' && service.operation !== 'verify')
				throw new Error('非法恢复动作');
			const result = await service.run({ ...own, signal });
			if (disposed || ticket !== epoch) return;
			// 403 的事实由宿主替换页面输入；一次读回不能在本页伪造解锁。
			if (own.kind === 'forbidden' || result.status === 'denied') {
				setFeedback({
					value: {
						phase: 'denied',
						message: '当前仍无访问权限，请联系资源负责人。'
					},
					key: 'app.templates.results.accessIsStillDeniedContactTheResourceOwner'
				});
			} else if (result.status === 'confirmed') {
				setFeedback({
					value: { phase: 'confirmed', message: '已核实结果，可以继续。' },
					key: 'app.templates.results.theResultHasBeenVerifiedYouCanContinue'
				});
			} else {
				setFeedback({
					value: { phase: 'failed', message: '仍未恢复，请稍后重新核实或返回。' },
					key: 'app.templates.results.stillUnavailableVerifyAgainLaterOrReturn'
				});
			}
		} catch (error) {
			if (!disposed && ticket === epoch) {
				setFeedback({
					value: {
						phase: 'failed',
						message: '本次读取失败，原结果未改变。可重新核实或返回。'
					},
					key: 'app.templates.results.thisReadFailedTheOriginalResultIsUnchangedVerify'
				});
				throw error;
			}
		}
	}
	async function go(intent) {
		if (!available()) return;
		if (
			intent === 'next' &&
			!(
				(input.kind === 'success' && input.confirmed === true) ||
				(['failure', 'server-error'].includes(input.kind) &&
					feedback.value.phase === 'confirmed')
			)
		)
			return;
		const requested = intent === 'return' ? input.returnTarget : input.nextTarget;
		const target =
			requested && host.allows(requested)
				? requested
				: intent === 'return'
					? host.fallback
					: undefined;
		if (!target || !host.allows(target)) {
			setFeedback({
				value: { phase: 'failed', message: '没有可用的导航目标，请联系页面负责人。' },
				key: 'app.templates.results.noNavigationTargetIsAvailableContactThePageOwner'
			});
			return;
		}
		const previousPhase = feedback.value.phase;
		const ticket = ++epoch;
		const own = Object.freeze({ ...input });
		abort = new AbortController();
		const signal = abort.signal;
		setFeedback({
			value: { phase: 'busy', message: '正在打开目标页面…' },
			key: 'app.templates.results.openingTheTargetPage'
		});
		try {
			const accepted = await host.navigate(target, { ...own, signal });
			if (disposed || ticket !== epoch) return;
			setFeedback(
				accepted
					? { value: { phase: 'idle', message: '' } }
					: {
							value: {
								phase: previousPhase === 'confirmed' ? 'confirmed' : 'failed',
								message: '页面未能打开，原业务结果不受影响。请重新导航。'
							},
							key: 'app.templates.results.thePageDidNotOpenTheOriginalBusinessResult'
						}
			);
		} catch (error) {
			if (!disposed && ticket === epoch) {
				setFeedback({
					value: {
						phase: previousPhase === 'confirmed' ? 'confirmed' : 'failed',
						message: '导航失败，原业务结果不受影响。请重新导航。'
					},
					key: 'app.templates.results.navigationFailedTheOriginalBusinessResultIsUnchangedTry'
				});
				throw error;
			}
		}
	}
	return {
		feedback: readonly(feedback),
		formatMessage: (scope) =>
			scope.enabled.value && feedbackKey.value
				? templateText(scope, feedbackKey.value)
				: feedback.value.message,
		replace,
		recover,
		go,
		dispose() {
			if (!disposed) {
				disposed = true;
				invalidate();
			}
		}
	};
}
css
.result-page {
	--result-paper: var(--asam-color-surface-page);
	--result-surface: var(--asam-color-surface, #fff);
	--result-text: var(--asam-color-text-primary, #252a2c);
	--result-muted: var(--asam-color-text-regular, #434343);
	--result-line: var(--asam-color-border, #d9dedf);
	--result-accent: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	--result-wash: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);
	--result-brand-bg: var(--asam-semantic-primary-soft);
	--result-brand-text: var(--asam-semantic-primary-foreground);
	--result-tech-canvas: var(--asam-color-surface-muted);
	--result-height: var(--asam-density-default-height, 32px);
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	min-height: calc(100dvh - 64px);
	box-sizing: border-box;
	background: var(--result-paper);
	color: var(--result-text);
	font-family: var(--asam-typography-font-family);
	line-height: 1.6;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
.result-page[data-theme='dark'] {
	color-scheme: dark;
}
.result-page[data-size='large'] {
	--result-height: var(--asam-density-large-height, 40px);
}
.result-page[data-size='big'] {
	--result-height: var(--asam-density-big-height, 36px);
}
.result-page[data-size='small'] {
	--result-height: var(--asam-density-small-height, 28px);
}
.result-wordmark {
	font-size: 14px;
	font-weight: 650;
	letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.result-page .el-result {
	padding: 0;
	align-items: stretch;
	text-align: left;
}
.result-page .el-result__title {
	margin: 0;
}
.result-page .el-result__title p {
	font-size: clamp(26px, 3.2vw, 42px);
	font-weight: 600;
	line-height: 1.3;
	letter-spacing: -0.03em;
	color: var(--result-text);
}
.result-page .el-result__subtitle {
	margin-top: 20px;
}
.result-page .el-result__subtitle p {
	color: var(--result-muted);
	line-height: 1.8;
	max-width: 50ch;
}
.result-page .el-result__extra {
	margin-top: 24px;
	text-align: left;
}
.result-page .asam-state-panel-actions {
	justify-content: flex-start;
	gap: 12px;
}
.result-page .asam-state-panel button:not([class*='el-']) {
	min-height: var(--result-height);
	padding: 0 18px;
	border-color: var(--result-line);
	color: var(--result-text);
	background: var(--result-surface);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control, 6px);
}
.result-page .asam-state-panel button:not([class*='el-']):first-child {
	background: var(--asam-semantic-primary-solid);
	color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-on-solid);
	border-color: var(--asam-semantic-primary-solid);
}
.result-page .asam-state-panel button:not([class*='el-']):focus-visible {
	outline: 3px solid var(--asam-semantic-focus);
	outline-offset: 4px;
}
.result-page .asam-state-panel button:not([class*='el-']):active {
	transform: scale(0.98);
}
.result-details {
	color: var(--result-muted);
	font-size: 13px;
	max-width: 65ch;
}
.result-details p {
	margin: 0 0 16px;
}
.result-path bdi {
	display: block;
	font-family: Consolas, monospace;
}
.result-feedback {
	min-height: 24px;
	color: var(--result-text);
}
.result-sr {
	position: absolute;
	width: 1px;
	height: 1px;
	clip-path: inset(50%);
	overflow: hidden;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
	.result-content {
		animation: result-enter 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
	.result-page button:not([class*='el-']) {
		transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
	}
}
@keyframes result-enter {
	from {
		transform: translateY(6px);
	}
	to {
		transform: translateY(0);
	}
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	.result-page .el-result__title p {
		font-size: 28px;
	}
	.result-page .asam-state-panel-actions {
		gap: 10px;
	}
}

import { useTemplateI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory as createWebHistory } from 'vue-router';
import { defineComponent, h, ref } from 'vue';
import { createNavigation } from '../navigation/Navigation.js';
import ResultRoute from './ResultRoute.vue';
import { createSyntheticService } from './Service.js';
const requestedFamily = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('family');
export const family = ref(
	requestedFamily === 'brand' || requestedFamily === 'tech' ? requestedFamily : 'minimal'
);
export const theme = ref(
	requestedFamily === 'tech' || matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches
		? 'dark'
		: 'light'
);
export const size = ref('default');
export const mode = ref('confirm');
export const longText = ref(false);
export const empty = ref(false);
export const disabled = ref(false);
export const readonly = ref(false);
export const owner = ref('demo-reader');
export const mounted = ref(true);
export const double = ref(false);
export const navigationFails = ref(false);
export const synthetic = createSyntheticService();
const Landing = defineComponent(() => {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	return () =>
		h('main', { class: 'demo-landing' }, [
			h('h1', i18n.t('app.templates.results.workspace')),
			h('p', i18n.t('app.templates.results.navigationArrived'))
		]);
});
const Record = defineComponent(() => {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	return () =>
		h('main', { class: 'demo-landing' }, [
			h('h1', i18n.t('app.templates.results.record')),
			h('p', i18n.t('app.templates.results.verifiedDemoRecord'))
		]);
});
export const router = createRouter({
	history: createWebHistory(),
	routes: [
		{ path: '/', redirect: '/home' },
		{ path: '/success', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'success' } },
		{ path: '/failure', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'failure' } },
		{ path: '/403', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'forbidden' } },
		{ path: '/404', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'not-found' } },
		{ path: '/500', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'server-error' } },
		{ path: '/:pathMatch(.*)*', component: ResultRoute, meta: { resultKind: 'not-found' } }
	]
});
// 032 的固定同版源码快照，只读且原字节；本应用拥有此实例并负责释放。
export const navigation = createNavigation({
	router,
	components: { home: Landing, record: Record },
	fallback: '/home',
	scope: 'synthetic-workspace',
	load: async () => [
		{ id: 'home', path: '/home', title: '工作台', resource: 'home', cache: false },
		{ id: 'record', path: '/record', title: '处理记录', resource: 'record', cache: false }
	]
});
export const targets = Object.freeze({
	home: 'home',
	record: 'record'
});
export function createHost() {
	return {
		allows: (target) =>
			Object.hasOwn(targets, target) &&
			navigation.menu.value.some((item) => item.id === targets[target]),
		navigate: (target, context) =>
			context.signal.aborted ||
			context.owner !== owner.value ||
			context.route !== router.currentRoute.value.fullPath ||
			navigationFails.value
				? false
				: navigation.navigate(navigation.location(targets[target])),
		fallback: 'home',
		recovery: synthetic.service(mode.value)
	};
}
/** 示例宿主决定结果种类；不根据任意错误数字推断业务成功。 */
export function inputFor(kind, route, instance = 'primary') {
	const identity = {
		id: `synthetic-${instance}`,
		route,
		owner: owner.value,
		scope: 'workspace-demo',
		revision: 1
	};
	const common = {
		...identity,
		returnTarget: 'home',
		nextTarget: 'record',
		disabled: disabled.value,
		readonly: readonly.value,
		...(longText.value
			? {
					title: '这是一条需要在较窄屏幕上完整阅读并且允许自然换行的处理结果标题',
					description: '请核对本次处理的状态与相关说明。'.repeat(12)
				}
			: {}),
		...(empty.value
			? { title: '', description: '', correlationId: '' }
			: { correlationId: 'DEMO-READ-824' })
	};
	if (kind === 'success') return { ...common, kind, confirmed: true };
	if (kind === 'failure' || kind === 'server-error')
		return { ...common, kind, writeState: 'unknown' };
	if (kind === 'not-found') return { ...common, kind, unknownPath: route.split('?')[0] };
	return { ...common, kind };
}
export function disposeOwnedRuntime() {
	navigation.dispose();
	synthetic.dispose();
}

/** 只在当前浏览器内合成读取，没有 fetch、账户或业务写入。 */
export function createSyntheticService() {
	let calls = 0;
	const outstanding = new Map();
	let disposed = false;
	function service(mode) {
		return {
			operation: 'verify',
			run(context) {
				if (disposed) throw new Error('示例服务已关闭');
				calls++;
				if (mode === 'throw') throw new Error('合成同步失败');
				if (mode === 'reject') return Promise.reject(new Error('合成异步失败'));
				return new Promise((resolve) => {
					const finish = () => {
						outstanding.delete(timer);
						context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
						resolve(
							mode === 'denied'
								? { status: 'denied' }
								: mode === 'fail'
									? { status: 'still-failed' }
									: { status: 'confirmed' }
						);
					};
					const cancel = () => {
						clearTimeout(timer);
						finish();
					};
					const timer = setTimeout(finish, mode === 'late' ? 900 : 80);
					outstanding.set(timer, cancel);
					context.signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
					if (context.signal.aborted) cancel();
				});
			}
		};
	}
	return {
		service,
		get calls() {
			return calls;
		},
		dispose() {
			disposed = true;
			for (const cancel of [...outstanding.values()]) cancel();
		}
	};
}

<!-- eslint-disable vue/html-indent -- Template layout follows the repository Prettier configuration. -->
<template>
	<main
		class="result-page minimal-page"
		:class="{ 'minimal-receipt': businessResult }"
		:data-theme="theme"
		:data-size="size ?? 'default'"
		data-family="minimal"
	>
		<header class="minimal-mast">
			<span class="result-wordmark">{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.asamWorkspace') }}</span
			><span>{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.operationResult') }}</span>
		</header>
		<component
			:is="businessResult ? AsamCard : 'div'"
			v-bind="
				businessResult
					? {
							shadow: 'never',
							bordered: true,
							bodyStyle: { padding: 'var(--asam-space-xl, 24px)' }
						}
					: {}
			"
			class="minimal-body"
			><div
				v-if="!businessResult"
				class="minimal-index"
				:data-code="content.code"
				:data-kind="input.kind"
				aria-hidden="true"
			>
				{{ content.code }}
			</div>
			<component
				:is="panel"
				:title="title"
				:description="description"
				:tone="tone ?? content.tone"
				:actions="actions"
				:state-key="stateKey"
				:size="size"
				:readonly="input.readonly"
				:disabled="input.disabled"
				@start="start"
				@success="success"
				@failure="failure"
				class="result-content"
				><template v-if="!businessResult && !nativeIcon" #icon
					><span class="result-sr">{{ content.code }}</span></template
				><slot name="receipt" :input="input" />
				<div class="result-details">
					<p v-if="path" class="result-path">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.requestedPath') }} <bdi>{{ path }}</bdi>
					</p>
					<p v-if="correlation">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.correlationId') }}
						<bdi>{{ correlation }}</bdi>
					</p>
					<p v-if="input.kind === 'failure' && input.writeState === 'unknown'">
						{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.theWriteResultIsUnknownVerifyIt') }}
					</p>
					<p class="result-feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite">
						{{ feedback.message }}
					</p>
				</div></component
			></component
		>
		<footer class="minimal-foot">
			{{ i18n.t('app.templates.results.everyStepHasAClearDestination')
			}}<span>ASAM WORKSPACE</span>
		</footer>
	</main>
</template>
<script setup>
import { useTemplateI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
import { AsamCard } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
import { useResultPage } from '../useResultPage.js';
import { computed, nextTick, onScopeDispose, useSlots } from 'vue';
const props = defineProps({
	tone: { type: String, required: false },
	nativeIcon: { type: Boolean, required: false },
	actionLabels: { type: Object, required: false },
	primaryAction: { type: String, required: false },
	printReceipt: { type: Function, required: false },
	input: { type: Object, required: true },
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	theme: { type: String, required: false },
	verifyOnly: { type: Boolean, required: false }
});
const businessResult = computed(() => props.input.kind === 'success');
const slots = useSlots();
const emit = defineEmits(['start', 'success', 'failure']);
const {
	content,
	actions: navigationActions,
	panel,
	path,
	correlation,
	stateKey,
	feedback,
	start,
	success,
	failure
} = useResultPage(props, emit);
const title = computed(() =>
	businessResult.value && slots.receipt && props.input.title === undefined
		? i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSuccessTitle')
		: content.value.title
);
const description = computed(() =>
	businessResult.value && slots.receipt && props.input.description === undefined
		? i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSuccessDescription')
		: content.value.description
);
let active = true;
onScopeDispose(() => {
	active = false;
});
const actions = computed(() => {
	const ownState = stateKey.value;
	// 展示属性通过getter读取，避免文案/主色变化替换030仍在执行的动作。
	const existing = navigationActions.value.map((action) => ({
		id: action.id,
		run: action.run,
		get disabled() {
			return action.disabled;
		},
		get button() {
			return props.primaryAction === action.id
				? { type: 'primary', plain: false }
				: action.button;
		},
		get label() {
			return props.actionLabels?.[action.id] ?? action.label;
		}
	}));
	if (props.verifyOnly) return existing.filter((action) => action.id === 'recover');
	if (!businessResult.value || !slots.receipt) return existing;
	return [
		...existing
			.filter((action) => action.id === 'next')
			.map((action) => ({
				...action,
				button: { type: 'primary', plain: false },
				get label() {
					return i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptViewRequest');
				}
			})),
		{
			id: 'print-receipt',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptPrint');
			},
			run: async () => {
				await nextTick();
				if (
					active &&
					stateKey.value === ownState &&
					props.input.kind === 'success' &&
					props.input.confirmed &&
					!props.input.disabled &&
					!props.input.readonly
				)
					await (props.printReceipt ?? (() => window.print()))(
						Object.freeze({ ...props.input })
					);
			}
		},
		...existing.filter((action) => action.id !== 'next')
	];
});
</script>

export function templateText(scope, key) {

			} catch (cause) {

				menu.value
					.filter(
						(old) =>
							!next.some(
								(item) =>
									item.id === old.id &&
									item.path === old.path &&
									item.resource === old.resource
							)
					)
					.map((item) => item.id)
			);

			for (const tab of tabs.value) {

	}
	function prune() {

			tabs.value.some((tab) => tab.cache && tab.cacheKey === key)
		);
	}
	async function close(ids) {

		const closing = tabs.value.filter((tab) => ids.includes(tab.id) && !tab.pinned);
		if (!closing.length) return true;
		const token = ++action;
		if (!(await permitted('close')) || disposed || token !== action) return false;

			if (!(await navigate(survivor?.fullPath ?? options.fallback))) return false;

	}
	async function refresh(id = active.value) {

import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { computed, nextTick, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamException, AsamStatePanel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createResultController } from './Controller.js';
export function useResultPage(props, emit = () => {}) {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	const copy = computed(() => ({
		success: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.submissionComplete'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theHostConfirmedTheResultViewTheRecordOr'),
			code: i18n.t('app.templates.results.complete'),
			tone: 'success'
		},
		failure: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theOperationDidNotComplete'),
			description: i18n.t(
				'app.templates.results.verifyTheLatestResultBeforeDecidingWhatToDo'
			),
			code: i18n.t('app.templates.results.needsAttention'),
			tone: 'warning'
		},
		forbidden: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.thisPageIsCurrentlyUnavailableToYou'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.youDoNotHaveAccessToThisResourceRead'),
			code: '403',
			tone: 'warning'
		},
		'not-found': {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.pageNotFound'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theAddressMayHaveChangedCheckThePathOr'),
			code: '404',
			tone: 'info'
		},
		'server-error': {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theServiceIsTemporarilyUnavailable'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.noResultWasReceivedReadTheStatusAgainOr'),
			code: '500',
			tone: 'error'
		}
	}));
	const controller = createResultController(props.input, props.host);
	// 只跟随 030 公开事件固定 actions 身份，按钮 pending/disabled/aria-busy 仍全部由 030 管理。
	const executing = shallowRef(false);
	const generation = shallowRef(0);
	let disposed = false;
	const stateKey = computed(() =>
		JSON.stringify([
			props.input.id,
			props.input.kind,
			props.input.route,
			props.input.owner,
			props.input.scope,
			props.input.revision,
			props.input.disabled,
			props.input.readonly
		])
	);
	watch(
		() => [stateKey.value, props.input, props.host],
		() => {
			generation.value++;
			executing.value = false;
			controller.replace(props.input, props.host);
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	onScopeDispose(() => {
		disposed = true;
		generation.value++;
		controller.dispose();
	});
	function start(id) {
		executing.value = true;
		emit('start', id);
	}
	function success(id) {
		// 此时 030 已完成本次执行。先释放，再通知宿主，允许回调同步启动下一次动作。
		executing.value = false;
		emit('success', id);
	}
	function failure(id, error) {
		executing.value = false;
		emit('failure', id, error);
	}
	const verified = computed(
		() => props.input.kind !== 'success' || props.input.confirmed === true
	);
	const content = computed(() => ({
		...copy.value[props.input.kind],
		title: verified.value
			? props.input.title || copy.value[props.input.kind].title
			: i18n.t('app.templates.results.resultNotYetConfirmed'),
		description: verified.value
			? props.input.description || copy.value[props.input.kind].description
			: i18n.t('app.templates.results.waitForTheHostToConfirmTheBusinessResult'),
		tone: verified.value ? copy.value[props.input.kind].tone : 'info'
	}));
	const actions = computed((previous) => {
		const own = generation.value;
		// feedback 已结算不代表 030 的 await 已结算；直到其真实终结事件才更新动作列表。
		if (executing.value && previous) return previous;
		const run = (action) => async () => {
			// start 回调可以同步替换输入/卸载；先让 Vue 提交这些变更，再核本动作身份。
			await nextTick();
			if (!disposed && own === generation.value) await action();
		};
		const list = [];
		if (
			props.host.recovery &&
			['failure', 'server-error', 'forbidden'].includes(props.input.kind)
		)
			list.push({
				id: 'recover',
				get label() {
					return props.input.kind === 'forbidden'
						? i18n.t('app.templates.results.readPermissionsAgain')
						: i18n.t('app.templates.results.verifyAgain');
				},
				run: run(controller.recover)
			});
		if (
			props.input.nextTarget &&
			props.host.allows(props.input.nextTarget) &&
			((props.input.kind === 'success' && verified.value) ||
				(['failure', 'server-error'].includes(props.input.kind) &&
					controller.feedback.value.phase === 'confirmed'))
		)
			list.push({
				id: 'next',
				get label() {
					return i18n.t('app.templates.results.viewRecord');
				},
				run: run(() => controller.go('next'))
			});
		list.push({
			id: 'return',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.results.returnToWorkspace');
			},
			run: run(() => controller.go('return'))
		});
		return list;
	});
	const panel = computed(() => (props.input.kind === 'success' ? AsamStatePanel : AsamException));
	const path = computed(() =>
		props.input.kind === 'not-found' ? props.input.unknownPath.slice(0, 160) : ''
	);
	const correlation = computed(() => props.input.correlationId?.slice(0, 80) || '');
	return {
		content,
		actions,
		panel,
		path,
		correlation,
		stateKey,
		feedback: computed(() => ({
			...controller.feedback.value,
			message: controller.formatMessage?.(i18n) ?? controller.feedback.value.message
		})),
		start,
		success,
		failure
	};
}

展示已确认的申请回执，并为失败、未知、拒绝和错误结果提供读取核实与合法返回。

摘要、步骤与打印入口由成功回执演示提供；结果身份、合法导航和读取核实沿用同一模板协议。

接入与状态约束

完整 Vue 应用提供三个可编辑布局族，使用本地合成服务；业务写入、登录、权限与后端恢复由应用负责。

族 完整 SFC 构图
克制简约 families/MinimalResultPage.vue 细分隔、左侧结果标识、文档式正文与留白
品牌分栏 families/BrandResultPage.vue 品牌侧区、几何品牌符号、独立内容栏；窄屏收为品牌条
深色科技 families/TechResultPage.vue 宽幅状态文字、双层恢复面板、分离页脚；默认深色

三个族都使用同一控制器与 状态组件 公开 AsamStatePanel / AsamException，不复制结果组件内部算法。模板 CSS 只调整页面构图、tokens 和公开组件的必要内部布局，不重做基础控件。40/36/32/28 对应 large/big/default/small。显式 theme 可选择明暗，示例默认遵循系统。

路由 kind 恢复行为
/success success 宿主明确 confirmed:true，下一步或返回；不重复写入
/failure failure 读取/核实、返回；核实确认后提供下一步
/403 forbidden 重新读取权限仍保持拒绝，宿主另行决定替换路由输入
/404 及真实未匹配路径 not-found 文本显示实际路径，截至 160 字符；返回合法 fallback
/500 server-error 读取最新状态、返回；不展示异常对象/堆栈/HTML

每条路由可直接打开、刷新。部署静态 SPA 时必须为无文件路径回退 index.html，不能把服务器自身 404 冒充前端未知路由。示例静态验证服务器已实现此策略。

移动到普通工程 ​

复制完整目录并保留 navigation 源码、配套补丁与相对依赖，按所用 ASAM/Element Plus 版本核对。

从 npm 安装配对的 UI 和 Pro，见 Pro 快速开始。下载的完整工程包含用于复现示例的锁文件。安装依赖后启动工程：

powershell
pnpm install --offline --ignore-scripts
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run build
pnpm run dev

离线安装需要预先备齐精确依赖、补丁和有效锁。保留 workspace 的 patch、overrides 与依赖检查配置，依赖在目标工程独立安装。

接入已有页面 ​

从 index.ts 导入一个完整族，传入 ResultPageProps。借入宿主的 router/navigation/controller 时由宿主清理；页面卸载只停止自身监听、失效展示代次并发出 AbortSignal，不 dispose 宿主、不宣称取消真实业务。完整输入、动作与生命周期见接口与行为，本页提供完整工程与源码下载。

无旧结果模板 API 的破坏迁移。由自建静态结果页迁移时，先固定 result identity / explicit kind / 返回 allowlist 与读取服务，再迁移外观；移除 history.length、任意外部 returnUrl 和自动重写循环。成功与导航失败分别处理。示例工具栏、合成状态和测试开关属于演示宿主，可由业务宿主替换。

三族公开事件同为 start(id)、success(id)、failure(id,error)，在组件上显式监听。success 是动作完成；业务是否恢复仍看反馈与可信宿主输入。异常保持原对象交给 failure 处理，UI 只显示安全文案。直接使用控制器时须捕获 Promise 拒绝。完整例子和重入/失效语义见 API。

接口与行为

本文件与 Types.ts、Controller.ts、三个族 SFC 同版本。没有隐式 store、会话或全局单例要求。

ResultPageProps ​

字段 责任
input:ResultInput 宿主只读快照；替换对象或身份/路由/结果代次即失效旧展示
host:ResultHost 显式 allowlist、导航、fallback、可选读取恢复；宿主拥有此对象
size large/big/default/small，40/36/32/28；默认 default
theme light/dark；tech 缺省 dark，其他族 light，示例在宿主遵循系统

input 必需 id/route/owner/scope/revision/kind。同一结果 ID 被重新使用时递增 revision。传对象快照，不原位修改嵌套业务对象。身份切换需在宿主同步更新 owner/scope，不能等旧请求结束才更新。

success 必须 confirmed:true；failure/server-error 必须声明 writeState:'unknown'|'failed'；not-found 必须 unknownPath；forbidden 不推断认证状态。title/description 缺省或空串使用本地默认文案。所有内容按 Vue 文本输出；未知路径截 160 字符，公开关联 ID 截 80 字符。关联 ID 的非秘密性是宿主输入约束，不把任意 error 对象传给页面。

可选 returnTarget/nextTarget 是宿主 allowlist 的 key，不是 URL。disabled/readonly 均阻止所有页面行动。页面不接受任意重定向字符串、动态 import 字符串或 HTML。

ResultHost ​

导航实际签名为 navigate(target, context)：context 含固定结果身份与 AbortSignal。延迟执行的宿主必须在实际副作用前核 signal/owner/scope；示例在调用 导航模板 前核 signal、owner 和当前 route。页面会在替换/卸载时中止此 signal，忽略迟到结算。已开始且不支持取消的业务副作用不能被模板撤销。

allows(target) 检查宿主固定资源映射；navigate(target, context) 返回 boolean 或 Promise。示例的 key 映射到 导航模板 navigation.location(id)，再调用其公开 navigate()。无效 returnTarget 使用经过同样 allowlist 核查的 fallback；无有效 fallback 显示无法导航。无有效 nextTarget 不提供下一步。没有历史长度推断，直接加载同样可返回。

recovery.operation 仅 read/verify；run(context) 接收固定结果身份与 signal，返回 confirmed/still-failed/denied。同步 throw 与异步 reject 统一安全文案，原异常不渲染。未知写入不能自动重发。读取 confirmed 只在 failure/500 提供下一步，不自动导航；403 任何读回仍显示拒绝，由宿主在可信权限更新后决定是否换页。恢复出错后可再次显式读取。

示例的 createSyntheticService() 在本地用有限定时器合成行为，不请求真实服务器。dispose() 清本实例定时器和 abort 监听。真实宿主需要自行处理业务幂等、取消能力及权限，不由模板代管。

createResultController<TInput extends ResultInput> ​

返回 feedback/replace/recover/go/dispose。泛型约束 replace() 接受的输入类型。feedback 为只读 ref，phase 为 idle/busy/confirmed/failed/denied，message 为安全文本。recover()、go('return'|'next') 返回 Promise；忙时重入无操作。replace() 同步递增代次、abort 展示请求、清反馈。dispose() 幂等，不销毁借入资源。

SFC 用 stateKey 将 id/kind/route/owner/scope/revision/禁用只读串联给 状态组件，并在输入或 host 替换时同步失效控制器。每次操作捕获当前代次；旧动作的 resolve/reject 不覆盖新页、不触发后继导航。已开始的宿主导航/真实业务副作用由宿主负责，页面取消展示不等于撤销副作用。

状态组件 负责实际动作按钮、busy 与基础事件；模板用显式 actions 和自身反馈补充业务恢复语义。三个族没有复制的状态算法。两实例各自控制器互不影响；示例 runtime 的 导航模板 与 synthetic 实例是应用自有，应用卸载时释放，族组件本身不 dispose 它们。

三族公开事件（同一签名） ​

三族显式声明并原样转发 状态组件 的 start(id:string)、success(id:string)、failure(id:string,error:unknown)，类型为 ResultPageEmits。每次合法执行一次 start，仍属于当前身份的执行只产生一次终结事件。终结来自正常 状态组件 await，模板不合成 DOM 事件。

success 表示注入动作正常完成；still-failed/denied 是合法读回，同样 success，但页面仍 failed/denied，403 不解锁。同步 throw/异步 reject 先更新安全反馈，再将原异常按 failure 第二参数交回宿主；原异常绝不渲染。导航返回 false 是正常完成的拒绝结果；导航 throw/reject 才 failure。直接调用控制器的宿主须捕获 recover/go 的拒绝。

动作数组保持到 状态组件 的真实终结事件，随后才反映 confirmed 等状态；下一步及输入/host 替换仍会更新。start 回调可同步修改输入或卸载，模板在 Vue 提交这些变更后核动作代次，阻止旧服务启动；已启动服务在替换/卸载后取消 signal，忽略其迟到 resolve/reject。宿主 success/failure 回调可同步再点击或替换输入。busy、disabled、aria-busy 继续直接来自 状态组件。

vue
<MinimalResultPage
	:input="input"
	:host="host"
	@start="(id) => audit('start', id)"
	@success="(id) => audit('settled', id)"
	@failure="(id, error) => handleActionError(id, error)"
/>

事件只提供动作协议；宿主自行决定日志内容，不向 UI 或外部日志转发敏感异常。

视图与无障碍 ​

使用原生 button、焦点 outline、公开状态 aria-busy 与 role=status/aria-live=polite。默认不抢夺键盘焦点。手机自然纵向布局，长文换行、路径双向隔离。轻入场只变 transform；减少动态无动画且功能相同。状态不只靠颜色区分，代码/标题/说明同时表达。

完整类型

ts
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { Ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamControlSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';

export type ResultKind = 'success' | 'failure' | 'forbidden' | 'not-found' | 'server-error';
export type ResultFamily = 'minimal' | 'brand' | 'tech';
export interface ResultIdentity {
	id: string;
	/** 当前宿主路由完整路径。 */
	route: string;
	owner: string;
	scope: string;
	/** 同一结果被替换时递增。 */
	revision: number;
}
export type ResultInput = ResultIdentity & {
	title?: string;
	description?: string;
	/** 只允许公开关联 ID，禁止传入凭据或堆栈。 */
	correlationId?: string;
	returnTarget?: string;
	nextTarget?: string;
	disabled?: boolean;
	readonly?: boolean;
} & (
		| { kind: 'success'; confirmed: true }
		| { kind: 'failure' | 'server-error'; writeState: 'unknown' | 'failed' }
		| { kind: 'forbidden' }
		| { kind: 'not-found'; unknownPath: string }
	);
export type RecoveryOutcome =
	| { status: 'confirmed'; message?: string }
	| { status: 'still-failed'; message?: string }
	| { status: 'denied' };
export interface ReadRecovery {
	/** 此契约只允许读取或核实，不能用来重发业务写入。 */
	operation: 'read' | 'verify';
	run: (
		context: Readonly<ResultInput> & { signal: AbortSignal }
	) => RecoveryOutcome | Promise<RecoveryOutcome>;
}
export interface ResultHost {
	/** key 到目标的映射由宿主显式定义，并由 032 navigation 处理。 */
	allows: (target: string) => boolean;
	/** 延迟实际导航的宿主必须在副作用前核对 signal 与此固定身份。 */
	navigate: (
		target: string,
		context: Readonly<ResultInput> & { signal: AbortSignal }
	) => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
	fallback: string;
	recovery?: ReadRecovery;
}
export interface ResultPageProps {
	/** 仅展示层覆盖，不改变原动作或结果状态。 */
	tone?: 'success' | 'error' | 'warning' | 'info';
	/** 显示公共状态组件原生图标；默认保留旧简约页的代码标记。 */
	nativeIcon?: boolean;
	actionLabels?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
	/** 将已有具名动作按公共按钮主色呈现，不新增或替换动作。 */
	primaryAction?: string;
	/** 简约回执可接入内容区预览；未提供时保持原浏览器打印行为。 */
	printReceipt?: (context: Readonly<ResultInput>) => void | Promise<void>;
	input: ResultInput;
	host: ResultHost;
	size?: AsamControlSize;
	theme?: 'light' | 'dark';
}
/** 原样转发 030 的动作协议；success 表示动作完成，不等同于业务恢复。 */
export interface ResultPageEmits {
	start: [id: string];
	success: [id: string];
	failure: [id: string, error: unknown];
}
export interface ResultPageEmitter {
	(event: 'start', id: string): void;
	(event: 'success', id: string): void;
	(event: 'failure', id: string, error: unknown): void;
}
export interface ResultFeedback {
	phase: 'idle' | 'busy' | 'confirmed' | 'failed' | 'denied';
	message: string;
}
export interface ResultController<TInput extends ResultInput = ResultInput> {
	feedback: Readonly<Ref<ResultFeedback>>;
	formatMessage?: (scope: AsamI18n) => string;
	replace: (input: TInput, host?: ResultHost) => void;
	recover: () => Promise<void>;
	go: (intent: 'return' | 'next') => Promise<void>;
	dispose: () => void;
}
